autonomyLevels.label: Approval required
autonomyLevels.body: The agent acts only after a human approves the specific action.

autonomyLevels.label: Limited autonomy

autonomyLevels.label: Full autonomy
autonomyLevels.body: The agent acts and reports. Recommended only for reversible, low-risk steps.

autonomyLevels.label: Reporting only
autonomyLevels.body: Read-only: the agent analyses and reports, and cannot change anything.

faq.q: What can the agents actually do without a human approving it?
faq.a: It is your decision, per action type. Research and analysis run read-only. Sending email, issuing a discount or touching a refund starts in an approval state until you deliberately grant more autonomy. Every permission change is written to the audit log with the person who made it.

faq.q: How do you stop an agent from saying something wrong to a customer?
faq.a: Three layers: an approval policy on outbound messages, guardrails that constrain what an agent may claim or promise, and an Agent Supervisor that watches for anomalies during a run, pauses the workflow and escalates to a human when something looks out of policy.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our CRM?
faq.a: No. RevenuePilot connects to the systems you already run — Gmail or Microsoft 365 for email, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or Zoho for CRM, and your calendar for booking. CRM writes are field-level allowlisted and reversible, so your system of record stays your system of record.

faq.q: How is revenue attributed, and can we audit the method?
faq.a: Every touchpoint is recorded, and revenue is attributed along the path that produced it. The method and its weights are documented and visible in the product, so a finance team can inspect how a number was reached rather than trusting a black box.

faq.q: Is our data used to train models?
faq.a: No. Your workspace data is not used to train shared or third-party models. You can export everything as JSON or CSV, and you can delete a workspace and its derivative data on request.
Per workspace per month, with volume bands. Agent cost is metered and visible, and you can set a hard budget ceiling that pauses agents instead of overspending.

Connect a mailbox, a calendar and a CRM, import a prospect list, then choose the autonomy level for each action. Most teams have an agent running in a supervised mode the same day, and widen its permissions as trust builds.

faq.q: What happens when something breaks at 2am?
faq.a: The Supervisor detects the failed run, pauses the affected workflow rather than retrying blindly, and raises it in the exception queue. There is also a single kill switch that pauses every agent in the workspace immediately.
